notes.title: Catch Me! X Steam Scream Fest Event
notes.content:
Say Hello to your New Adventure!

During the [b]Steam Scream Fest[/b],  we have prepared a limited-time event for players in the game . Every time you enter the battle scene, find the pumpkin in the scene exclusively for you, triggering the Halloween surprise play!

When you are immersed in the fun of spell casting, a Halloween pumpkin suddenly appears in the scene, catch it, a [b]Fire Dragon[/b] jumps out of it, and becomes your partner in the adventure journey. It will fly above the table and constantly breathe fire to help you quickly capture the enemy tower and have final victory! Catch me! is a limited-time event during the Steam Scream Fest, and we will also arrange huge discounts on the game, so stay tuned for our new version update, don't miss this limited-time experience!


Catch me for a limited time during the festival, and we will also arrange [b]a Huge Discount[/b] on the game, so stay tuned for our new! Don't miss this limited experience!

notes.title: [New Update] Roguelike Gameplay
notes.content:
Dear Tower Defenders,

It is our pleasure to present to you the Roguelike gameplay with the desire of providing a better and more immersive experience. We are excited to announce the features you can experience in this version:

⚔️5-level Boss mechanism: Every time you complete 4 levels, you get a Boss level. Defeat him and carry on your journey!
⚔️ Four immersive environments: Forest, Snowland, Desert, and Cemetery.
⚔️ More abilities for our heroes: You can now freely choose and build your deck. Strategize and Prevail.
⚔️ Battle Experience: Your soldiers and towers will gradually become more powerful as you defeat more enemies and complete more levels.

As we are constantly improving and updating our product, any advice from you is most valuable to us. We welcome you to join our official [url=https://discord.gg/XaANxFTN6B] Discord [/url] and talk to us. We will be regularly gifting free Steam Keys, organizing votes, and events. Various scenes, amelioration for player interactions, and online mode are also on our roadmap. Please follow us and pay close attention to our future updates!

Love from Team SUPLIFE
